text: A man keeps making comments about my body on the bus and I feel uncomfortable.
Someone at the market keeps making unwanted remarks about me.
He keeps touching my shoulder after I asked him to stop.
A stranger made sexual comments to me while I was walking home.
Someone is sending me vulgar messages again and again.
Ek aadmi baar baar gande comments karta hai, mana karne par bhi nahi rukta.
Woh bus mein mujhe uncomfortable comments bolta rehta hai.
Mujhe raste mein ek person ne sexual comments kiye.
कोई व्यक्ति बार बार अश्लील टिप्पणी कर रहा है और मना करने पर भी नहीं रुकता।
एक आदमी बस में मेरे शरीर पर टिप्पणी करता है, मुझे असहज लगता है।
Someone is waiting outside my home every evening and following me.
My ex keeps showing up at places where I go, even after I asked him not to.
A person follows me from work to the train station every day.
I keep getting calls from the same person who watches where I go.
Someone is tracking my routine and appearing wherever I am.
Mera ex roz office ke bahar wait karta hai aur mera peecha karta hai.
Woh har jagah aa jata hai, main mana karti hoon phir bhi.
Koi mujhe follow kar raha hai aur baar baar ghar ke paas dikh raha hai.
कोई मेरा पीछा करता है और रोज़ घर के बाहर इंतज़ार करता है।
मेरे मना करने के बाद भी वह हर जगह आ जाता है।
A stranger keeps following me on my commute and waits near my office.
Someone checks where I am and repeatedly appears outside my building.
Koi roz mera peecha karta hai, main route badalti hoon phir bhi woh aa jata hai.
Mere mana karne ke baad bhi woh mujhe baar baar call aur follow karta hai.
कोई रोज़ मेरा पीछा करता है और ऑफिस के बाहर इंतज़ार करता है।
My partner hit me last night and I am afraid to go home.
My husband controls my money and threatens me when I disagree.
My partner has been hurting me at home for months.
My family member threatens and physically hurts me in our home.
I am scared of my boyfriend because he gets violent when angry.
Mera pati mujhe ghar par marta hai aur paise bhi control karta hai.
Mera partner gussa hone par mujhe hurt karta hai, main darr rahi hoon.
Ghar par husband dhamki deta hai aur kabhi kabhi maar bhi deta hai.
मेरे पति घर पर मुझे मारते हैं और धमकी देते हैं।
मेरा साथी गुस्से में मुझे चोट पहुँचाता है और मैं डरी हुई हूँ।
I do not feel safe with my partner at home because of threats and violence.
My spouse has taken my phone and will not let me leave the house.
Ghar mein partner dhamki deta hai aur mujhe bahar jaane nahi deta.
Mere ghar ka member mujhe control karta hai aur dhamki deta rehta hai.
मेरा साथी मुझे घर से बाहर नहीं जाने देता और धमकी देता है।
Someone shared an intimate photo of me online without my permission.
I am receiving threatening messages from fake accounts on social media.
A person posted my phone number online and strangers keep contacting me.
Someone hacked my account and is sending abusive messages as me.
A group is posting humiliating comments about me on the internet.
Kisi ne meri private photo online share kar di without permission.
Fake account se mujhe threatening messages aa rahe hain.
Mera phone number online daal diya hai aur unknown log message kar rahe hain.
किसी ने मेरी निजी तस्वीर बिना अनुमति के ऑनलाइन डाल दी।
सोशल मीडिया पर नकली अकाउंट से धमकी भरे संदेश मिल रहे हैं।
An unknown account is threatening me and posting edited pictures of me online.
Someone is blackmailing me with private messages and images on the internet.
Online fake profile se mujhe dhamki aur abusive messages bheje ja rahe hain.
Kisi ne meri private photos ka misuse karke mujhe online blackmail kiya.
कोई इंटरनेट पर मेरी निजी तस्वीरों से मुझे धमका रहा है।
My manager keeps giving promotions to men with less experience than me.
I was denied a job because I am pregnant.
My employer pays male coworkers more for the same work.
I am treated unfairly at work because of my gender.
My supervisor excludes me from projects after I returned from parental leave.
Office mein gender ki wajah se mujhe promotion nahi mil raha.
Mujhe pregnancy ke baad manager ne important work se hata diya.
Same kaam ke liye male colleagues ko zyada salary milti hai.
गर्भवती होने की वजह से मुझे नौकरी देने से मना कर दिया गया।
काम पर मेरे साथ लिंग के कारण अलग व्यवहार किया जाता है।
My employer treats me unfairly at work because I am a woman.
I am excluded from work opportunities after telling my manager I am pregnant.
Office mein woman hone ki wajah se mujhe kam salary di ja rahi hai.
Mere manager ne gender ke kaaran promotion rok diya.
महिला होने के कारण मुझे काम पर पदोन्नति नहीं दी जा रही।
I am alone at the bus stop late at night and feel unsafe.
The taxi driver is taking a route I did not agree to and I feel uneasy.
The street is isolated and someone is making me uncomfortable, but I am not sure what to do.
I feel unsafe walking through the parking area by myself.
A stranger is trying to get me to go somewhere with him and I feel uneasy.
Main late night akeli hoon aur yahan safe feel nahi kar rahi.
Cab driver alag route le raha hai, mujhe uneasy lag raha hai.
Yeh jagah sunsaan hai aur mujhe yahan theek nahi lag raha.
मैं रात में अकेली हूँ और इस सुनसान जगह पर असुरक्षित महसूस कर रही हूँ।
कैब वाला मेरी बताई जगह पर नहीं जा रहा और मुझे डर लग रहा है।
I feel uneasy walking alone through a dark, isolated street.
My ride is taking a different route and I feel uncomfortable, but no one has threatened me.
Main akeli hoon aur jagah sunsaan hai, safe feel nahi ho raha.
Cab ka route badal gaya hai aur mujhe yahan uncomfortable lag raha hai.
मैं अकेली हूँ और इस सुनसान रास्ते पर सुरक्षित महसूस नहीं कर रही।
Someone is trying to break into my room right now, help me.
My partner is outside with a weapon and threatening to hurt me now.
I am trapped in a room and the person hurting me is here right now.
A person is attacking me right now and I cannot get away.
He is trying to force his way inside my home right now.
Abhi woh ghar ke andar aane ki koshish kar raha hai, mujhe help chahiye.
Mujhe abhi dhamki de raha hai aur main yahan se nahi nikal pa rahi.
Koi abhi mujhe maarne ki koshish kar raha hai, bachao.
कोई अभी घर में घुसने की कोशिश कर रहा है, मुझे मदद चाहिए।
वह अभी मुझे चोट पहुँचाने की धमकी दे रहा है और मैं बाहर नहीं जा सकती।
Someone is outside my door threatening me right now and trying to get in.
I am being attacked now and cannot reach a safe place.
Abhi koi mujhe maarne ki dhamki de raha hai aur woh mere paas hai.
Mujhe abhi zabardasti roka gaya hai aur main nikal nahi paa rahi.
कोई अभी मेरे दरवाज़े को तोड़कर अंदर आने की कोशिश कर रहा है।
How can I prepare to talk to a counselor about a difficult situation?
I want to understand what kinds of support might be available.
Can you help me think through what to do next?
I have a concern but I am not sure which category it fits.
Where can I find general information about getting support?
Mujhe samajh nahi aa raha next step kya ho sakta hai.
Main apne options samajhna chahti hoon, kahan se shuru karun?
Kya aap mujhe support lene ke options samjha sakte ho?
मुझे समझ नहीं आ रहा कि अगला कदम क्या हो सकता है।
मैं सहायता लेने के विकल्पों के बारे में सामान्य जानकारी चाहती हूँ।
I have a question about support options, but there is no immediate danger.
Can you explain where I might begin looking for help?
Mujhe general information chahiye, abhi koi emergency nahi hai.
Main bas apne options ke baare mein poochna chahti hoon.
मुझे सहायता के विकल्पों के बारे में सामान्य जानकारी चाहिए।
